summary: A diary notes that people unhappy with a nominee seemed willing to support them anyway.
realLife: Strong wrote on May 31, 1860 that Seward's backers were unhappy with Lincoln's nomination but seemed ready to support it.
sources: Civil War Notebook, Strong's diary entry of May 31, 1860: https://civilwarnotebook.blogspot.com/2026/01/diary-of-george-templeton-strong.html
